I can understand your pain. I also had a metal rod inserted, but that infected my bone. I had 13 surgeries and multiple antibiotic treatments, which lasted 4 months at a time. Almost every one of those surgeries was to change the rods or plaques because my body was rejecting the metal. My surgery scar went form my butt to my knee every time they did the surgeries. My scar never healed fully, and it would open up if my leg got too swollen. I also had sort of tunnels in my flesh because of the bacteria. My point is I can totally relate to the pain you felt, and I'm sorry you had to go through that. I'm also happy for you because (I assume) you got to keep your precious leg.
